areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Recovers vulnerable degraded urban areas and builds resilience to floods, with mitigation and compensation of socio-environmental impacts.

areas.name: Basic sanitation
areas.reason: Urban drainage and sanitation are the programme's focus, with a major component on drainage solutions.

areas.name: Integrated water-resources management and water security
areas.reason: Integrated, resilient actions on risk management, drainage structures and water resilience address water-security deficits.

areas.name: Infrastructure and social facilities for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Resettlement subcomponent with housing, social rent and social work serves low-income residents of flood-prone areas; sizeable share of financing.
